preconditions: The display SPI bus must already be initialized.
Any board-local reset and backlight signals must be available if used.
steps: Reset the panel if a reset line is wired.
Send the panel sleep-exit and display-on command sequence.
Apply any project-local rotation, inversion, or backlight defaults.

validationHooks.description: Initialize the SPI peripheral for the panel bus.
validationHooks.passCriteria: The SPI bus is ready for device command traffic.
failureNotes: The bus must be configured before panel commands can be tested.

validationHooks.description: Transmit at least one known display command over the command path.
validationHooks.passCriteria: The command path completes without transport error.
failureNotes: A passing command-path test does not guarantee pixel rendering is correct.

validationHooks.description: Toggle backlight if that signal exists.
validationHooks.passCriteria: The mapped backlight signal responds when present.
failureNotes: Shared reset wiring must be documented if the display reset line is multiplexed.

checks: Initialize the SPI peripheral for the panel bus.
Transmit at least one known display command over the command path.
Toggle backlight if that signal exists.
smokeTest.passCriteria: The command path completes without transport error and any backlight control responds.
failureNotes: A passing command-path test does not guarantee pixel rendering is correct.
Shared reset wiring must be documented if the display reset line is multiplexed.

highLevel.name: display_init
highLevel.description: Bring the panel out of reset and apply the standard init sequence.

highLevel.name: display_set_backlight
highLevel.description: Control the board-mapped backlight output when present.

highLevel.name: display_write_command
highLevel.description: Send a low-level command for bring-up and diagnostics.
